title: Turning 36: Pavel Durov's seven habits for staying young and healthy
summary: Durov lists seven habits shared by people who look younger than their age: no alcohol, lots of sleep, not overeating, regular exercise, low stress, no meat, and living alone. It is a personal health essay with no direct lessons on growth, marketing, pricing or building a business.

principles.text: Never drink alcohol; it silences your intuition about what is good or bad for you.
principles.quote: NEVER DRINK ALCOHOL. Once you give up on alcohol, you’ll stop silencing your intuition, which will tell you what is good and what is bad for you.

principles.text: Sleep a lot; you can't borrow or compensate lost sleep later.
principles.quote: Sleep is when your body repairs itself. You can’t borrow it: lack of sleep during the week can’t be compensated with oversleeping on the weekend.

principles.text: Limit stress with mental habits like Stoic techniques and believing events happen for the better.
principles.quote: Stoic techniques such as negative visualisation and generally not giving a shit also work.

principles.text: Independence from unhealthy societal norms lets you work out what's right for yourself instead of relying on others' advice.
principles.quote: You will figure out everything you need to know by yourself and won’t depend on other people for advice.
